title: Flix Syntax TreeKind Inventory Schema
description: Schema for ast/treekind.json, enumerating all syntax tree node kinds reflected from the pinned Flix reference compiler.

generatedBy.description: Fully qualified generator that produced this file.

toolVersion.description: Generator version; bumped when output format or selection logic changes.

upstreamCommit.description: flix/flix commit this inventory was derived from.

oracleSha256.description: SHA-256 of the oracle jar actually used. Two different jars exist at the pinned commit (release asset vs self-built), so the artifact must be named, not assumed.

name.description: Qualified syntax tree node kind name (e.g. Expr.Apply, Decl.Def, ErrorTree).

extends.description: Qualified parent trait name within SyntaxTree (e.g. Expr, Decl, TreeKind).

form.description: JVM representation form (case-object for singleton leaves, case-class for ErrorTree).
